title: Owen McGrail’s Body Found
authors: New Haven Daily Morning Journal and Courier
version: 23 March 1880 issue, page 1, Chronicling America newspaper page facsimile; LCCN sn82015483.
lineage: Contemporaneous local news account preserved in a newspaper page facsimile. The article describes a specific recovery and notification to the police office. It leaves the call's originating station, routing and telephone company unspecified.

passages.note: Page 1, Owen McGrail’s Body Found, account of the previous afternoon. The article reports that word was sent to the police office by telephone and that Ransom Smith and Acting Coroner Hugh Dailey went to the scene.
